name: Fake-Out
tagline: Write a fake answer. Find the real one.
description: A strange true fact appears with a blank. Everyone types a fake answer that sounds real, then all the answers are mixed with the truth and everyone picks the one they believe. Score for finding the truth and for every player your fake fools. The last question is worth double.

settings.label: Questions
settings.description: How many facts to play; the last one is the Final Fake-Out

settings.label: Lying time
settings.description: Seconds to write a fake answer

settings.label: Picking time
settings.description: Seconds to pick the answer you believe

settings.label: Final Fake-Out
settings.description: The last question doubles all points

settings.label: Suggest a lie
settings.description: Show the 💡 button that offers two ready-made fakes

settings.label: Likes
settings.description: Let players 👍 the funniest answers while they pick

settings.label: Categories
settings.description: Tick the categories to play; nothing ticked plays them all

settings.label: Spicy facts
settings.description: Mix in adult facts (drinking, dating, bawdy history; never explicit)

settings.label: Reader
settings.description: The voice that reads each fact and answer aloud
